text_block_list.text: Returning from an outing with Mejiro Ryan—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are, Ryan-chan! Hurry, 
hurry, come over here nano~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wah? W-What, what is it!?

Mejiro Ryan was whisked away by Ines 
Fujin, who had suddenly appeared. When I 
hurried after them—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "Everyone! I found Ryan-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Great job, Ines! Ryan, get on the court 
quick~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Um... What's up? In the middle of a 
volleyball match...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's a sudden grade-level battle! A 
back-and-forth seesaw game—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"And the pinch server who made a dashing 
entrance was none other than Ryan-chan~!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I-I was just dragged along out of the 
blue, though...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
“Still, if they're counting on me, I have 
to step up. Hold on just a second!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting. Alright, let's 
resume the match!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Go for it, Ryan! Score that service ace~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'll do my best! Cheer me on, 
okay?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's give it all we've got~! 
Total focus!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Ryan-chan is certainly pumped up. 
Dependable as always, yes~♪

The whistle blew, and the serve struck 
from Mejiro Ryan's hand—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —Hah!
(—Thud!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Not just service aces— after that, she put 
on an incredible show in both offense and 
defense!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing as always, Ryan-chan! All 
hail our Goddess of Victory~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Really, really! I'm so glad I brought Ryan 
along!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Hearing you say that makes me 
really happy!
choice_data_list: So you're quite the popular one, huh.

So you're quite the popular one, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Hearing you say that makes me 
really happy!
choice_data_list: So you're quite the popular one, huh.

So you're quite the popular one, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Ryan-chan is super popular, 
everyone's always clamoring for her!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Right?! Don't you think so too?!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! Ryan, you're our hero!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I-It's a little embarrassing, but... 
Hehe. Thank you!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So I can live up to everyone's 
expectations... I'll keep trying my best, 
in my own way!

Even when called in as a last-minute 
substitute, Mejiro Ryan performed 
brilliantly, her refreshing presence 
making it obvious why she's so popular.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much! Ehehe, that makes 
me a little shy.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Eeeek! Ryan-chan's Trainer is so bold...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Woo-hoo! Yeah, nano!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: Woo-hoo! Everyone's watching, you know~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? N-No, it's not like that at all... 
Jeez!

Surrounded by her classmates, Mejiro Ryan 
looks bashful. It seems she is a 
dependable and popular figure even in 
class.
